blocks.text: Policy violations represent deviations from established security policies detected on assets within the Asset Exposure Management (AEM) app in the Zscaler SecOps platform. Clicking a policy violation on the Policy Violations page opens the violation's drawer, where you can view detailed information including the affected asset, policy name, and severity score. You can also perform multiple actions for the violation. To learn more, see About Policy Violations.
The actions you can perform in the violation drawer depend on your user role in the AEM app. To learn more, see Understanding System Roles and Creating Custom Roles.
To view the policy violation drawer:

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, click Policy Violations.
